The '''Desert Plain''' was a flat plain on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], located near the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], the [[Arch Canyon/Legends|Arch Canyon]] and [[Beggar's Canyon/Legends|Beggar's Canyon]]. The plain was part of the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] racetrack and was considered as light relief from the other sections of the circuit.<ref name="ItWoSWE1">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:Desert_Plain_Jawa.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] in the Desert Plain.]]

During the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|podrace]] of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Bardottan/Legends|Phuii]] racer [[Mars Guo/Legends|Mars Guo]] crashed in this plain after the cheating [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] tossed a piece of iron in one of the turbines of his [[Plug-2 Behemoth|podracer]].<ref name="ItWoSWE1" />
